## `neuro.string.trimStart`

Instance method on `String.prototype`.

> Removes the leading white space and line terminator characters from a string.

## Signatures

```ts
trimStart(input: { string: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `String.prototype.trimStart` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.

## Example

<Code
  lang="ts"
  code={atob("")}
  wrap
/>
